run_GTestFilterUnitTest: run the Google Test filter unit tests to verify test filtering and sharding behavior
test_SetEnvVar: test the SetEnvVar utility function that sets or unsets environment variables for subprocess invocation
test_RunAndExtractTestList: test the RunAndExtractTestList function that runs a test binary and parses the list of tests executed
test_InvokeWithModifiedEnv: test the InvokeWithModifiedEnv utility that runs a function with temporary environment variable overrides
test_RunWithSharding: test the RunWithSharding function that runs a test program shard and returns exit code and tests run
